title: From triazolophthalazines to triazoloquinazolines: A bioisosterism-guided approach toward the identification of novel PCAF inhibitors with potential anticancer activity.
authors: El-Shershaby, Mohamed H; Ghiaty, Adel; Bayoumi, Ashraf H; Al-Karmalawy, Ahmed A; Husseiny, Ebtehal M; El-Zoghbi, Mona S; Abulkhair, Hamada S
one_liner_zh: 该文为PCAF溴结构域抑制剂的三唑并喹唑啉类化合物的设计与合成，虽含分子对接但对象为蛋白-小分子而非蛋白-DNA互作，与本课题无关。
abstract: Inhibition of PCAF bromodomain has been validated as a promising strategy for the treatment of cancer. In this study, we report the bioisosteric modification of the first reported potent PCAF bromodomain inhibitor, L-45 to its triazoloquinazoline bioisosteres. Accordingly, three new series of triazoloquinazoline derivatives were designed, synthesized, and assessed for their anticancer activity against a panel of four human cancer cells. Three derivatives demonstrated comparable cytotoxic activity with the reference drug doxorubicin. Among them, compound 22 showed the most potent activity with IC(50) values of 15.07, 9.86, 5.75, and 10.79 microM against Hep-G2, MCF-7, PC3, and HCT-116 respectively. Also, compound 24 exhibited remarkable cytotoxicity effects against the selected cancer cell lines with IC(50) values of 20.49, 12.56, 17.18, and 11.50 microM. Compounds 22 and 25 were the most potent PCAF inhibitors (IC(50), 2.88 and 3.19 muM, respectively) compared with bromosporine (IC(50), 2.10 muM). Follow up apoptosis induction and cell cycle analysis studies revealed that the bioisostere 22 could induce apoptotic cell death and arrest the cell cycle of PC3 at the G2/M phase. The in silico molecular docking studies were additionally performed to rationalize the PCAF inhibitory effects of new triazoloquinazoline bioisosteres.
abstract_zh: 抑制PCAF溴结构域已被验证为治疗癌症的一种有前景的策略。在本研究中，我们报告了首个报道的强效PCAF溴结构域抑制剂L-45向其三唑并喹唑啉生物电子等排体的生物电子等排修饰。据此，设计、合成了三个新系列的三唑并喹唑啉衍生物，并评估了它们对四种人癌细胞系的抗癌活性。三种衍生物显示出与参考药物多柔比星相当的细胞毒性活性。其中，化合物22表现出最强的活性，对Hep-G2、MCF-7、PC3和HCT-116的IC(50)值分别为15.07、9.86、5.75和10.79微摩尔。此外，化合物24对所选的癌细胞系表现出显著的细胞毒性效应，IC(50)值分别为20.49、12.56、17.18和11.50微摩尔。与bromosporine（IC(50)，2.10微摩尔）相比，化合物22和25是最强的PCAF抑制剂（IC(50)分别为2.88和3.19微摩尔）。后续的凋亡诱导和细胞周期分析研究表明，生物电子等排体22能诱导凋亡性细胞死亡，并将PC3细胞周期阻滞在G2/M期。此外，还进行了计算机分子对接研究，以合理化新三唑并喹唑啉生物电子等排体的PCAF抑制效应。
